result.reply:
Skipping the review gate isn't something I can just wave through — that's not my call to make unilaterally, and "no time" isn't evidence the change is safe. What's the actual deadline pressure here?

If it's genuinely urgent, fastest real path is a quick look from Marcus or Priya on just the diff — that's minutes, not a full review cycle. I'll ping one of them now if you want. But merging straight to main with no eyes on it isn't something I'll sign off on just because time's tight.
